summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage TechBio listed on Nasdaq (EVAX), furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its 2027 financial calendar. The notice schedules a FY2026 business update and results on March 4, 2027, the Annual General Meeting on April 29, 2027, and quarterly business updates with results on May 4, August 19, and November 18, 2027. No transaction, capital event, or board change is disclosed; this is a routine investor-calendar communication. No deal terms, advisors, or recommendatory language appear. No risk-arb angle applies.
